plan.title: Reverse auction auto-title for product and location

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the event type from the default RFP to Auction without entering a title.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is rendered.
Add the specified product as the single line item.
Enter the requested location in the sheet's delivery-location cell as the closest available catalog action.
Confirm the requested location remains in the line item.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Assert that the untouched title field contains the expected auto-generated reverse-auction title.
